name: CoA Custom races: characters of the added races are created with their model, start and racials
contract: Stage 1 of the CoA Custom races takes the race ids 9 and 12-63 from the CoA Custom 1.5.1 package.

Needs the package's client-coupled server DBCs (ChrRaces, CharSections, CharStartOutfit, CreatureDisplayInfo, CreatureModelData) in the worldserver's DataDir; without them ChrRaces lacks the added races and creation fails.
Package ChrRaces gives High Elf (14) male display 15476, Broken (22) 977439 and Void Elf (59) 977445, all Alliance (faction template 1).
Murloc (30) has no dressable player model: custom_race_display index 0 (hair style 0, skin 0) of the male Murloc is 977392, which InitDisplayIds applies instead of the ChrRaces model.
rev_20261012_10 starts High Elf in Shadowglen (template race 4, map 1) and Broken in Shadowglen too.

Every race from 12 up learns its four package racials (spell_dbc 140000xy); Worgen (13) also shares the Night Elf bit in playercreateinfo_skills (raceMask 4104), and learnSkillRewardedSpells must keep the Night Elf racial line (skill 126, Shadowmeld 58984) away from it.
Native race, display, map and known spells are observed; the client's character screen is not rendered.

steps.label: CONTROL: the High Elf is created as race 14
The High Elf wears the ChrRaces male model
The High Elf starts in Kalimdor (Shadowglen)
The High Elf knows its first package racial
The High Elf knows its fourth package racial
The Worgen knows its own package racial
DISCRIMINATING: the Worgen does not learn Shadowmeld through the shared Night Elf bit
The Broken wears the package model above 65535
The Broken knows its package racial
DISCRIMINATING: the Murloc wears its custom_race_display look, not the ChrRaces model 977435
The Murloc knows its package racial
The Void Elf (race above 32) wears its model
The Void Elf knows its package racial by exact race id
